summary: Adds a new test file that exercises watches through every router backend type (forward, aggregate, single-tenant, in-process) in standalone and middleware modes. It covers streaming, watch-list bookmarks, timeoutSeconds, client disconnect, half-open breaker release, separate watch metrics, backend replacement, service stop and upgrade rejection. It is test-only and cannot affect production, so a short skim is enough.
headline: New acceptance tests for router watches across all backends and modes
reason: New test-only file with no production code; it adds coverage and removes no assertions or tests.
